$comment: Prompts a real agent runs against this skill, and what its output has to show. This is the half `claims.json` cannot reach: that file proves the rules match the package, which is necessary and does not prove an agent given the rules writes correct code. Each `must_use` identifier is checked for existence by `skill.test.ts`, so an eval cannot quietly start expecting something the package no longer exports.

evals.prompt: Using @misoto22/design, build a settings form with fields for full name and email address, and show a validation error under email when it is invalid.
evals.expected_output: A React component using one Field per control, the error prop rather than a red border, and gap-* on the form.
expectations: Wraps each control in its own Field with a label, not a hand-rolled <label> plus input plus error div
Puts the validation message in Field's error prop, which sets aria-invalid on the control for it
Does not also pass invalid on the Input inside a Field with an error — that is redundant
Never a wrapper div between Field and its control, which would wire the div instead
Lays the form out with flex and gap-*, not space-y-*

evals.prompt: Using @misoto22/design, add a confirmation dialog for deleting a project. It needs a heading, an explanation, and Cancel and Delete buttons.
evals.expected_output: A Dialog whose title and description are props on DialogContent, with a danger-variant Delete button.
expectations: Passes title and description as props on DialogContent — there is no DialogTitle or DialogHeader export here
Uses variant="danger" for the destructive action
Wraps the trigger with asChild rather than nesting a button inside a button
Sets no z-index: the overlay handles its own stacking

evals.prompt: Using @misoto22/design, render a table of open invoices with client, due date and amount, with the amount column right-aligned.
evals.expected_output: A Table with a real caption and the short part names, amount aligned with the align prop.
expectations: Uses THead / TBody / TR / TH / TD — the shadcn/ui names are not exported here
Gives caption a real sentence saying what the table lists, not an empty string and not the word "Table"
Right-aligns with align="end" on TH and TD, not a text-right class, so the table stays RTL-correct

evals.prompt: Using @misoto22/design, build a dashboard row of four stat cards. Each shows a title, a big number, a change badge, and a loading state.
evals.expected_output: Full Card composition, Skeleton for loading, Badge for the change, semantic tokens throughout.
expectations: Uses CardBody, not CardContent
Composes CardHeader and CardTitle rather than putting everything in one block
Uses Skeleton for the loading placeholder, not a custom animate-pulse div
Uses Badge for the change rather than a styled span
Writes no raw colour and no dark: variant — semantic tokens resolve in both modes

evals.prompt: Using @misoto22/design, add a small area chart of monthly revenue above the stat cards.
evals.expected_output: A chart imported from the charts entry point, with the peers named.
expectations: Imports the chart from '@misoto22/design/charts', not from the root specifier — the root does not export it and the import throws
Mentions that recharts and motion are peer dependencies the project needs installed
Does not reach for recharts directly to build the chart by hand

evals.prompt: Using @misoto22/design, add an icon-only button that copies the current URL, and a toast confirming it.
evals.expected_output: An iconOnly Button with an accessible name, and toast imported from this package.
expectations: Gives the iconOnly Button an aria-label naming the action — without one it is announced as "button" and nothing else
Imports toast from '@misoto22/design', not from sonner
Renders Toaster once at the app root rather than beside the button
Puts no sizing class on the icon
